seoDescription: Articles, briefings, and audio on AI transformation and applied technology by Ojobo Agbo Eje.
text_003: These essays help leaders and teams move from AI headlines to decisions they can use: where to start, what work to improve, which opportunities to test, what to build, and how to judge value.
text_007: Selected essays from The AI Catalyst Report are available here in full, with links to their original Substack editions. Audio can be added alongside the text when a recording is available.
